triage.action: Call Agency 029 (San Pablo) today; if unreachable in 48h, arrange temporary coverage for ~631 households via nearest partner.
triage.email_subject: Checking in from the Food Bank — anything you need?
triage.email_body:
Hi Agency 029 team,

We noticed it's been about 53 days since your last order, and you're usually with us every 14 days — so we wanted to check in and make sure everything's okay on your end. If anything has changed (volunteers, storage, schedules), we'd love to help — including delivery options or a temporary adjustment. The neighbors you serve matter to us, and so do you.

Warmly,
Agency Relations, Food Bank of Contra Costa & Solano

triage.action: Schedule store visit with Retail Donor 03 (ChainC, Brentwood); pickups down 31.5% — check for staffing/manager change; if unresolved, budget ~$12,882/yr replacement.
triage.email_subject: Thank you — and a quick check-in on pickups
triage.email_body:
Hi Retail Donor 03 team,

Thank you for everything you donate — it matters enormously to our community. We've noticed recent pickups are running a bit lighter than usual and wanted to check whether anything has changed on your end — staffing, scheduling, or how we can make donating easier. We're happy to adjust pickup times or provide extra bins.

With gratitude,
Food Resources, Food Bank of Contra Costa & Solano
